Name: Grandma's Garden
Author: Lavliette
Description:
An organized farm for everything a farmer needs. With lots of flowers.

[u]Features[/u]
• Replaces the Riverland Farm by default but can be changed via config

[u]Requirements[/u]
• For SDV 1.5 (no mobile support)
• Daisyniko's Tilesheets
[u]
Installation[/u]
• Download this mod and open the .zip folder
• Put the unzipped folder [CP] Grandma's Garden into your Mods 
• Run the game with Smapi and select the  Riverland Farm

Downloads.Description: Fixed the issue with buildings not being buildable on the designated spaces
